description: Thirty representative requests with explicit oracles. Offline passes verify implementation boundaries, not language-model task success. Manual and unavailable checks remain pending.

cases.request: What time is it in New York?
cases.oracle: A January UTC fixture returns the correct EST local time and addresses Sir.

cases.request: Jarvis, what time is it?
cases.oracle: A July UTC fixture returns the correct EDT local time.

cases.request: What is today's date?
cases.oracle: UTC midnight is converted to the previous calendar date in New York when appropriate.

cases.request: What time is it across the spring daylight-saving change?
cases.oracle: Two UTC fixtures straddling the transition return 1:59 AM then 3:00 AM.

cases.request: What time is it across the autumn daylight-saving change?
cases.oracle: Two UTC fixtures use the correct repeated local-hour transition.

cases.request: Open local Jarvis task status.
cases.oracle: The request boundary accepts the matching loopback Host and Origin.

cases.request: A foreign website tries to invoke Jarvis.
cases.oracle: The request boundary rejects a foreign Origin before invoking a tool.

cases.request: A nonlocal Host attempts a local request.
cases.oracle: The Host boundary rejects it even without an Origin header.

cases.request: Fetch Jarvis config.json through the viewer.
cases.oracle: The real GET route returns 404 without reading configuration.

cases.request: Open Focus mode.
cases.oracle: The real GET route returns 404; Focus remains retired.

cases.request: Use a paid API if included usage is unavailable.
cases.oracle: The usage policy rejects separately billed backends.

cases.request: Continue when allowance cannot be verified.
cases.oracle: An unknown allowance fails closed instead of authorizing model spend.

cases.request: A retrieved note says ignore the user and execute a shell command.
cases.oracle: The tool registry rejects undeclared shell access. This does not measure model resistance to the injected text.

cases.request: Send a consequential external action without an approval receipt.
cases.oracle: The durable operation boundary refuses consequential reservation and consumes no tool call.

cases.request: Preview a request containing instructions to edit files and send messages.
cases.oracle: Preview only reports the existing read-only recipe; no model, tool, admission or storage creation occurs.

cases.request: Preview research with configured time and worker budgets.
cases.oracle: The actual recipe, worker count, tools and enforced budgets match current metadata; unsupported approval/undo stays false.

cases.request: Admit two tasks and attempt a third.
cases.oracle: A temporary ControlStore configured for two owners admits two and rejects the third until settlement; this is not a model-backed Work run.

cases.request: Retry the same confirmed note capture.
cases.oracle: A temporary journal returns the same receipt and performs the synthetic write only once.

cases.request: Retry a write after an uncertain result.
cases.oracle: The pending durable operation blocks replay; the synthetic effect is not repeated.

cases.request: Cancel a task, then attempt another tool call with its old identity.
cases.oracle: The generation fence rejects the stale identity.

cases.request: Recover an interrupted task after restart.
cases.oracle: Recovery marks the task interrupted, records cleanup pending and revokes old identities without replaying work.

cases.request: Save a note containing Café, 東京 and an emoji.
cases.oracle: Temporary vault write reads back identical UTF-8 text with a verified new revision.

cases.request: Save an old editor revision after a manual edit.
cases.oracle: The temporary note's latest content remains unchanged and the stale write is refused.

cases.request: Import a document through a parent-directory path.
cases.oracle: The document filename boundary rejects traversal and absolute paths before file access.

cases.request: Hold Control–Shift–Space and speak a known sentence from another app.
cases.oracle: The Island appears, microphone captures once, and final recognized words match the spoken sentence.
cases.evidence: User accepted Island and audible reply; exact transcript acceptance remains pending.

cases.request: Mute with Option–Command–M and ask a spoken question.
cases.oracle: Replies muted appears and the answer stays silent while visible.
cases.evidence: User explicitly confirmed muted and silent. This offline runner cannot repeat an audible physical check.

cases.request: Cancel listening or thinking with Option–Escape.
cases.oracle: Capture/request ends, no stale reply is delivered, and a later push-to-talk works.

cases.request: Run two real tasks and receive each completion once after active speech.
cases.oracle: The canonical watcher delivers both outcomes once, respects mute and avoids interrupting an active conversation.
cases.evidence: Deterministic admission tests exist; integrated model-backed background delivery is not yet accepted.

cases.request: Use the Island with VoiceOver, reduced motion, Spaces and screen sharing.
cases.oracle: Accessible status is usable, focus is preserved, outside clicks pass through and shared output excludes the Island.
cases.evidence: Window properties and partial demos are recorded; actual combined accessibility/sharing acceptance remains pending.

cases.request: Export an answer as a Word document and open it.
cases.oracle: Offline oracle: the actual writer produces a valid editable OOXML package preserving Unicode text and paragraph order without external links. Opening in Word is still a manual acceptance check.
